findings.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA) in Payment Gateway API
findings.evidence: Autonomous agent successfully bypassed tenant authorization header on /api/v1/payments/charge?org_id=9812 to extract unauthorized billing transaction ledgers without admin token. Response code: HTTP 200 OK.
findings.controlState: WAF active but object-level authorization header validation omitted in microservice gateway.
findings.remediation: Implement server-side object-level permission verification and tenant scoping on all payment endpoints.

findings.title: Hardcoded GitHub Access Token in CI/CD Workflow Files
findings.vulnerability: Hardcoded GitHub Access Token in CI/CD Workflow Files
findings.evidence: Located active token ghp_**************************** in workflow YAML file. Validated token permissions: repo, write:packages, read:org.
findings.controlState: Git secret scanner inactive in pre-commit hooks.
findings.remediation: Revoke and rotate the exposed GitHub PAT. Configure GitHub Secret Store or HashiCorp Vault.

findings.title: Unencrypted Database Backup Archive Exposed on Local Mount
findings.vulnerability: Unencrypted Database Backup Archive Exposed on Local Mount
findings.evidence: Identified backup file backup_prod_dump_2026.sql without encryption on /var/backups/. File contains plaintext customer schema definitions.
findings.controlState: Disk encryption active but export archive lacks individual AES-256/GPG encryption.
findings.remediation: Enforce automated AES-256 / GPG encryption on all database dumps before file write.
